life_expectancy.text: The model considers monthly pensions until this age and aims to finish with a near-zero balance.

desired_monthly_net_income.text: Desired net income during retirement in today’s euros. The model keeps pace with inflation until life expectancy.

initial_balance.text: Starting balance in today’s euros. The model assumes this value has no prior gains to be taxed.

monthly_contribution.text: Monthly amount contributed to your investments in each year’s euros. It does not rise with inflation by default.

contribution_growth_rate.text: Annual increase rate to contributions in each year’s euros. 0% = no raise; inflation rate = constant purchasing power.

annual_roi.text: Annual market return-on-investment before inflation and fees. The model compounds using a Fisher real return.

inflation_rate.text: Expected annual raise in prices. Converts between each year's euros and today's euros; also used for the Real / Nominal toggle.

management_fee_rate.text: Annual funds and platform costs (TER, management, custody, etc.). Excludes buy/sell and other trading commissions.

gains_tax_rate.text: Capital gains tax rate on profits when you sell your investments. Oldest holdings are assumed to be sold first (FIFO).

warning.title: These values cannot be used
warning.wholeNumber: {field} must be a whole number from {min} to {max}.
warning.ageOrder: Current Age must be less than Life Expectancy.
warning.calculate: Could not calculate with these inputs.

coast.hint: Coast FIRE is reached when you can stop investing and still reach FIRE at the legal retirement age. Yellow line shows the growth trajectory from that point until FIRE.

units.hint:
Real values are amounts in today’s euros — future values are deflated to today's purchasing power.

Nominal values are amounts in each year’s euros — future values are shown as on that year's account statement.

table.title: Year-by-year
table.noteReal: All amounts in real values (i.e. in today's euros).
table.noteNominal: All amounts in nominal values (i.e. in each year's euros).
